what_it_does: This paper describes a radio receiver chip designed to work reliably when multiple unwanted radio signals (blockers) interfere with the signal you're trying to receive. The chip uses time-gated filtering and VCO-based signal processing (using a voltage-controlled oscillator as part of the filtering mechanism) to suppress multiple types of interference before digitizing the signal. By combining several filtering techniques — multilevel time-approximation filtering, N-path filtering, and smart sampling patterns — the receiver achieves high quality reception even in crowded spectrum environments.
